reason: Accepted research gives hand/foot healing worship, offerings, shrines, round sacred stone Okagami-ishi and historical warrior-origin spirit, but no deity bodily form or documented active manifestation. A static stone/shrine is landscape/object-only and fails Sangar; warrior-origin does not document Ashite Kōjin appearing as a samurai. No imported Shōmen Kongō anatomy or invented miraculous energy.
aura: Tidak divisualkan: ashite-kojin-c05 mendokumentasikan batuobjekvenerasi,c07/c08 ceritaorigin/healing, bukan wujuddeity/manifestasiaktif.
artistic_choices: Tidak mengimpor anatomy Shōmen Kongō dari asosiasi ashite-kojin-c04.
Tidak menggambar stonestatue/shrine pasif atau glowkesembuhan rekaan.
rationale: Every illustration must feel 'sangar': dangerous, imposing or awe-inspiring, with the being as the undeniable subject. The owner rejected earlier images that read as an ordinary person, an ordinary animal, an empty landscape, or a calm, cute or decorative portrait. Those outcomes are failures regardless of technical quality.
